entities.name: The Lord's Ark Church of Kraków

entities.summary: The Church of Our Lady Queen of Poland, known colloquially as The Ark of the Lord Church is a historic Roman Catholic parish church located at 1 Obrońców Krzyża Street in Nowa Huta, the former district of Kraków, Poland.
